title: C: Audit Zephyr implementation against anti-griefing spec updates
description:
After spec beads under worker6-h4pl are complete, sweep the C/Zephyr implementation to verify compliance:

Check each table/limit:
- Join tracking table bounds (hal or l2)
- Gradient table bounds (rpl)
- Neighbor table bounds (link layer)
- Trust store bounds (link security)
- Fragment context bounds (schc)
- Claim rate limiting (coap_slot_coord)
- DIO/DAO rate limiting (rpl)
- CoAP observer limits
- RREQ rate limiting (loadng)

For each: verify Kconfig exists with spec-compliant default, or add it.

Depends on: all spec beads under worker6-h4pl
